paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Associate/Manager, Finance role at Click Therapeutics. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role appeals to me because it covers the whole finance function at a company that is still building it, from budgets and board reporting to close support, and because you want someone to redesign finance workflows with AI tools rather than just keep them running.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget changes, and worked on AI powered dashboards, where I owned the requirements mapping and QA. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, handled cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of inflows, and worked on streamlining the order-to-cash process, which cut the cash conversion cycle by 20%.

That maps to the forecasting, board reporting and business partnering you describe. Digital therapeutics and FDA-regulated products would be new to me, so I'd spend my first weeks learning how revenue and spend actually move in the business. I'm comfortable owning a model end to end, explaining variances plainly, and helping the Controller when close gets busy. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
